Usage: astryx experimental [options] [command]

[experimental] Try features that may change in a patch release: icon sets (find icons, build an icon-set package)

Options:
  -h, --help                 display help for command

Commands:
  icon [options] [query...]  [experimental] Find an icon by meaning, or build an icon set from a library (guide: astryx docs cli/experimental/icon-sets)
  render [options] [file]    [experimental] Render a page to one self-contained HTML file, or turn one back into a page

Exit codes:
  0  help is shown or a subcommand succeeds
  1  an unknown subcommand or a subcommand failure

Examples:
  # List the experiments
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental
  # Find an icon by meaning
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon delete
  # Render a page to one HTML file
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental render page.tsx

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/experimental
